title: fix(platform-objects): the Users identity source reads "Local Account" instead of "Env-Native"
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X13YDEfngeSnxKczzPZGBXm)_

Refs #27855

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：用户的「身份来源」字段中，本地注册用户（存储值 `env_native`）原来显示 "Env-Native"，现在显示 "Local Account"，与联合登录的 "IdP-Provisioned" 并列；中文显示「本地账号」，日文「ローカルアカウント」，西班牙文「Cuenta local」。
- 为什么改：管理员在 Setup → Users 看到的是设计文档里的术语，看不懂（#27855 第三条）。
- 风险与回滚：只改选项标签，存储值 `env_native`、默认值和所有读取它的代码都不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`（`source` 字段），`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user-identity-source-label.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run src/identity/sys-user-identity-source-label.test.ts`，预期 6 passed（在 main 上 5 个红）。
- 需要你做的：通知主题（topic）可读化需要你拍板，平台没有不改字段类型、不改 ui 的纯显示途径，选项和分析见下方 Acceptance notes；#27855 保持打开。

## What changes

- `identity/sys-user.object.ts`: the `source` (Identity Source) option `env_native` is labelled **"Local Account"** (was "Env-Native"). Why this word: the field answers "where does this identity live", and its other option is "IdP-Provisioned" (held by an identity provider). An `env_native` user signed up with email and password in this environment, or is an app end-user, so the identity is a local account of this environment. The zh-CN object description already calls a user a 用户账号, so 本地账号 sits beside it. The stored value, the default and the description are unchanged.
- Translations: `zh-CN` 本地账号 (was 环境本地), `ja-JP` ローカルアカウント (was 環境ネイティブ), `es-ES` Cuenta local (was Nativa del entorno), re-translated in place in the generated bundles as their header asks. `en.objects.generated.ts` was regenerated by `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write --filter=platform-objects`; that run moved no other line, and none of these leaves has a `source-hashes` entry to refresh.
- Pin: `identity/sys-user-identity-source-label.test.ts`: the field stays a `select` over `idp_provisioned` / `env_native` with default `env_native`; the `env_native` label is "Local Account"; each of the four bundles carries its word.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch.

## Why

Every administrator on Setup → Users read "Env-Native" as a user's identity source, a term from the provenance design (ADR-0135 D4), not a business word.

## Acceptance notes

**Not in this PR: the readable notification topic (the card's other remaining part). It needs a maintainer decision; #27855 stays open.**

The dispatch ruled out a `select` that refuses unknown topics, any type, storage or value change, and `packages/spec/**` / `ui/**`. Measured at `origin/main` `35b178bd`, no display-only route reaches the face the card names (the Notifications list's Topic column):

- `options` parse on any field type, and two readers already honour them on a text field: the analytics dimension resolver (`service-analytics/src/dimension-labels.ts`, "never the field's `type`") and the grid's group header (`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridGrouping.ts`). The list cell does not: `TextCellRenderer` (`ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`) prints the stored text, and the record title is `titleFormat: '{topic}'`.
- The read-face `widget` hints a text field can promote to are a closed set of four reference faces (`object-ref`, `recipient-picker`, `position-ref`, `permission-ref`); none names a topic, and adding one is `ui/**`.
- A `select` would label known topics and, for an unknown one, the select cell falls back to `humanizeLabel` (`lead_routing` reads "Lead Routing"). It would not refuse anything if the field were `readonly`, as `sys_activity.type` is (the open-vocabulary ruling executed at commit 88b9d749a). But it is a type change: a `text` field is a TEXT column and a `select` falls to the SQL driver's `table.string(name)` (varchar 255), which the drift differ reports as `narrow_varchar` on existing tables.

The vocabulary, measured: 11 distinct topic literals in this repo (10 `approval.*` in plugin-approvals, plus `collab.mention`), plus the flow notify node's default `notify` (`io-node-config.zod.ts`, `topic: z.string()`); hotcrm `a598256` emits 19 more of its own (`lead_routing`, `deal_stalled`, …). The same key is what administrators type into `sys_notification_template.topic` and `sys_notification_preference.topic`, both free text matched against `sys_notification.topic`.

Options, for the decision record:

- **A.** Make `topic` a readonly `select` over the platform's built-in topics, following the `sys_activity.type` open-vocabulary pattern. Known topics read through translatable labels. Unknown topics are stored as written and drawn humanized. Costs: a type and column change (TEXT to varchar 255, a destructive drift finding on existing PostgreSQL and MySQL tables), and a census of the built-in topics that every new platform topic must extend in four locales.
- **B.** Keep `Field.text` and declare display-only `options` for the built-in topics. Group headers and analytics would read labels, but the list cell, the detail and the title stay raw until a ui card teaches the text cell to read `options`. Until then the declaration is honoured in only some places.
- **C.** Leave the topic as its key and close the rest of #27855. The key is what an administrator types into notification templates and preferences, so on this admin event log it is the value they need to see.

Recommendation: **C**. Along the four axes:
- Business need: the reach is real (every administrator on Notifications), but the raw key is the value the admin later types into templates and preferences.
- Long-term soundness: A buys a p3 label with a storage type change.
- Preventing AI mistakes: A's option list reads as closed to an AI author, which is exactly what the `sys_activity` ruling had to undo with a long description. B declares something the main face ignores.
- Startup focus: C adds no catalog, no census and no ui card.

If the maintainer wants the label anyway, A is the honest route, as its own card with the drift finding handled.

## Verification

Red first on `main` (test commit `cf9f9991` before the fix): `sys-user-identity-source-label.test.ts` 5 failed, 1 passed. The stored-value case stayed green, and the red ones received "Env-Native", 环境本地, 環境ネイティブ, Nativa del entorno. Green on this head: 6 passed.

Suites: `@objectstack/platform-objects` 105 files / 1480 tests pass; its typecheck (tsc, scripts, test-typecheck) passes; `eslint --no-inline-config packages/platform-objects` exit 0.

Gates at head `7164bb2a`: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 59 families; all 59 ran and exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 59 derived / 59 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first answered exit 3 (the shallow clone lacked its fixture commit); after `git fetch --depth=1` of that commit it exits 0. These include `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (after a full non-ui workspace build) and `check:type-check-debt`.

`git merge-tree` against the one open PR touching these bundles or this object file (#28525, head `b0284131`) merges clean.

Skills-docs: none — labels only; no published skill names the "Env-Native" label.
